none: PAS WMID-147A36: Roman Coin: Republican Denarius of Mark Anthony (41 BC)
contea di ritrovamento: Warwickshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Silver, Roman Republican, possibly clipped, denarius of Mark Anthony, dating to the year 41 BC (Reece Period: 1). Obverse depicts bust of Anthony right, the legend reads M.ANT.IMA [ ] BAR BAT R P. Reverse depicts bust of Octavian right. Minted by the officers of M. Antonius (and honours Octavian) whilst on the move with him in 41 BC.
